title: The Midnight Manuscript (v2 Fixed Scansion)
style: Classic 90s East Coast boom-bap, steady 90 BPM drum beat, punchy kick and snare on 2 and 4, smooth upright bassline, subtle jazz horn sample, clear authoritative male hip-hop vocals, relaxed flow locked to the beat, Rakim style.
lyrics:
[Verse]
I draft the craft in the dark on the page
An architect of intellect upon the stage
I walk the midnight mist where the silence is deep
And sharpen surgical designs while citizens sleep
My mental blueprint cannot stay or remain in-
-SIDE; it hits the downbeat as I step in my stride
I pace the empty blocks with a disciplined soul
And keep the sixteen dots in complete control
